test_title: PYST 42 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Choose the correct passive voice transformation of the sentence:**

Did Sanya pay the dinner bills?

options.text: The dinner bills did get paid by Sanya?
The dinner bills were paid by Sanya?
Did the dinner bills be paid by Sanya?
Were the dinner bills paid by Sanya?

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Did Sanya pay the dinner bills?"
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the dinner bills" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "did pay" to "were paid" (past simple passive).
